verdict.rationale: Digits documents substantial autonomous background work: auto-booking of 95%+ of transactions in real time, 24/7 AI bookkeeping and reconciliation, and an Agentic Close that continuously collects activity, books, reconciles, runs quality control and surfaces exceptions. Webhook event delivery also lets developers trigger their own downstream automations. However, these are built-in vendor-run processes, and nothing shows users defining, scheduling or configuring their own automations, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules or workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration by the user, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automation works as claimed.
